statement.name: get
statement.sql: select cast(lp.participant_id as varchar(36)) as id, lp.participant_name as name, lp.notification_preference_id as notifyPreferenceID, lp.participant_type_id as typeID from LU_PARTICIPANT lp

statement.name: getMembers
statement.sql: select cast(lp.participant_id as varchar(36)) as id, lp.participant_name as name, lp.notification_preference_id as notifyPreferenceID, lp.participant_type_id as typeID from rel_participant_hierarchy rph inner join lu_participant lp on rph.participant_id = lp.participant_id

statement.name: login
statement.sql: select cast(lpa.participant_id as varchar(36)) as participantId from lu_participant_auth lpa
